title: Leaks like crazy, doesn't heat anything
text:
Leaks like crazy, doesn't heat anything. Second unit purchased from Bissell (first was a green machine) and same result ..
Over time these units leak like crazy. This one only lasted 4 uses and now also leaks all over the place.
I now use with a plastic bin to collect the leakage .. instead of the dirty water going back all over my carpet in a new area.
Also bought this unit to get the heated water .. it doesn't work either
Will not buy again .. looking elsewhere

== UPDATE ==
Despite everything I could do to keep the gasket clear and well seated .. leaks all over the place (still)
If you buy this .. make sure you have a container to put the unit in to catch the leakage
